# pymizu

> Thread-speed async and parallel Python over shared memory

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Channels
> A two-way message link between a Python process and a helper process that it spawns.

- [Channel](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Channel.html): A shared-memory channel handle (process-private)

#### Task pools
> A set of worker processes that divide submitted tasks among themselves.

- [Pool](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Pool.html): A shared-memory work-stealing task pool handle (process-private)
- [Task](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Task.html): A task handle from Pool.submit(). It is collected exactly once, and an uncollected handle releases its slot when garbage collected
- [Map](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Map.html): The handle for one submitted map run
- [PreparedMap](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/PreparedMap.html): A reusable map staged in shared memory
- [PoolExecutor](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/PoolExecutor.html): A `concurrent.futures.Executor` backed by a pymizu pool

#### Cross-language interop
> R peers and workers (the mizu R package), neutral task specifications, and the data.frame's Python home.

- [call](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/call.html): A task specification for a pool of another language's workers
- [launcher](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/launcher.html): Return a launcher spawning Python processes running pymizu
- [r_launcher](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/r_launcher.html): Return a launcher spawning R processes running the `mizu` package
- [Frame](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Frame.html): A data.frame's Python home: named columns with a row count
- [DimArray](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/DimArray.html): An `ndarray` carrying R labels

#### Outcomes and errors
> A full ring, a timeout, a close, or a dead peer returns as a sentinel singleton — FULL / TIMEOUT / CLOSED / PEER_GONE — tested by identity, never raised. Real failures raise exceptions.

- [Sentinel](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/Sentinel.html): A terminal-state sentinel returned by pymizu verbs. Test by identity against pymizu.FULL / TIMEOUT / CLOSED / PEER_GONE
- [is_sentinel](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/is_sentinel.html): is_sentinel(x) -> bool
- [is_remote_error](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/is_remote_error.html): Test whether a received channel value is a remote error
- [MizuError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/MizuError.html): Base class for all pymizu errors
- [ShmError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/ShmError.html): A shared-memory region operation failed. Also an OSError: the failure is at the OS layer. Carries a 'bytes' attribute: the requested size of a region that was not created, None when a region was not opened
- [StartupError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/StartupError.html): A channel peer or pool worker failed to attach within the startup timeout
- [SubmitTimeoutError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/SubmitTimeoutError.html): Pool.submit() timed out waiting for injection-ring space. Also a TimeoutError
- [SlotsExhaustedError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/SlotsExhaustedError.html): Pool.submit() found no free result slot: too many outstanding (uncollected) tasks
- [StoppedError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/StoppedError.html): The pool is stopped; no further submission is possible
- [CancelledError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/CancelledError.html): The task was cancelled before it ran
- [TaskError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/TaskError.html): The task callable raised. Carries 'remote_type' and 'detail' attributes describing the worker-side exception
- [WorkerDiedError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/WorkerDiedError.html): The executing worker died mid-task. Carries 'slot' and 'pid' attributes identifying the worker
- [TaskLostError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/TaskLostError.html): The task's payload region vanished or could not be read before any worker ran it. No worker died
- [DeclinedError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/DeclinedError.html): A send on a foreign-language channel of a value outside the portable interchange subset. Carries 'path' and 'reason' attributes ('reason' includes the one-line rewrite guidance for the value)
- [ForeignPayloadError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/ForeignPayloadError.html): A received payload in a language-private or unrecognized format: the peer sent a value outside the portable interchange subset. The message is consumed, so the ring is never blocked, and under recv_async() only the Future waiting on that message rejects
- [ConcurrentUseError](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/ConcurrentUseError.html): A verb ran concurrently with another verb in the same handle role: each handle role is confined to one thread at a time (libmizu 'Handle threading')

#### Housekeeping
> The process-wide default pool, the current worker's own pool handle, and cleaning up shared memory left by dead processes.

- [default_pool](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/default_pool.html): The process-wide default pool, or None when none is set
- [set_default_pool](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/set_default_pool.html): Set the process-wide default pool; None clears it
- [using_pool](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/using_pool.html): Use ``pool`` as the default for the with block, then restore
- [current_pool](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/current_pool.html): The pool handle of the worker running the task
- [current_rng](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/current_rng.html): Return the current element's numpy Generator inside a seeded map
- [prune](https://shikokuchuo.net/pymizu/reference/prune.html): Remove orphaned shared memory regions
